title: Verify substitution dispatcher range-source overlap
changes: Compare the original byte-indexed substitution dispatcher prefix for all indices conditionally addressing the bounded-range owner, adjacent indices and high-byte aliases.
validation: Windows GNU build bounded-range-dispatcher-domain-build-zykm8vbp and Wine bounded-range-dispatcher-domain-wine-knxnixuk pass 96 complete-state/clock comparisons with all 88 range bytes altered: 88 in-range cases each serve four range bytes and eight adjacent cases serve none. Interpreter and generated instruction dispatch run; protected inputs pass, scratch removed and Wine drains.
limitations: The prefix stops before callback invocation; conditional indices do not establish ordinary reachability or callback safety. Other computed consumers, production cache selection, legacy IRQ equivalence, broader regressions, Linux, USA, native Windows and performance remain open; generated blocks may fall back to interpretation.
